pages.text: $(bold)Orbital Scan #0082$()$(br2)An EVA chestplate lined with Refined Acheronite.$(li)Keeps EVA breathable-air and O2 use$(li)Adds frostbite immunity$(li)Maximum cold resistance
Only the chestplate is lined. You still need the rest of the EVA rig, and air or O2 in late Phase 6.$(br2)$(italic)"Better than the orbital stabilizer?" "The one that caused the apocalypse? Yes."$()

pages.title: Lined EVA Suit
pages.text: Surround an EVA chestplate with Refined Acheronite. The suit will resist. Push harder.
